hooks.command: BR=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BR" = "main" ] || [ "$BR" = "master" ] || [ "$BR" = "dev" ]; then echo "⚠ 보호 브랜치($BR) 직접 편집 — 새 브랜치 권장. /insights Scope-Bound Edits Hard-stop 대상" >&2; fi; exit 0

AHEAD_BEHIND=$(git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...@{u} 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$AHEAD_BEHIND" ]; then BEHIND=$(echo $AHEAD_BEHIND | awk '{print $2}'); if [ "${BEHIND:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then echo "⚠ 현재 브랜치가 upstream 보다 ${BEHIND} 커밋 뒤짐 — Pre-Sprint Sync Check 권장: git fetch --all && git pull" >&2; fi; fi; exit 0

ZOMBIE=$(ps aux 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'mcp[-_]server|figma-developer-mcp|playwright-mcp' | grep -v grep | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "${ZOMBIE:-0}" -gt 5 ]; then echo "⚠ MCP 프로세스 ${ZOMBIE}건 누적 — 좀비 가능성. /insights 권장 정리: pkill -f mcp_server 또는 Claude Code 재시작" >&2; fi; exit 0

if git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -q '.claude-plugin/marketplace.json\|.claude/skills/kaizen-orchestrator/SKILL.md'; then python3 scripts/sync-orchestrator.py --check-only 2>&1 || echo '⚠ kaizen-orchestrator drift — run: python3 scripts/sync-orchestrator.py'; fi

if git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'skills/.*SKILL\.md|agents/.*\.md|\.claude-plugin/plugin\.json'; then python3 scripts/validate-plugin.py --check=refs,placeholders 2>&1 | tail -3 || true; fi
if git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'skills/.*SKILL\.md|agents/.*\.md|\.claude-plugin/plugin\.json|evals/'; then python3 scripts/validate-plugin.py 2>&1 | tail -3 || true; fi
if git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'harness/docs/guides/|harness/skills/|harness/agents/'; then echo '💡 harness 소스 변경 감지 — /docs-site 로 HTML 재생성 필요'; fi
